description: Local Turbo adapter, offered as an optional Big Love softness/sharpness adjustment. Strength 0.3 is a suggested starting point, not a verified preset.

compatibility.notes: Exact training provenance remains unknown. GPU smoke checked with Big Love Qiara1 BF16 at 512x512, two steps, seed 42, and strength -0.1 using the Qwen 2.1 workflow. Fused gate/up LoRA weights were split for Diffusers; all target modules matched and generation succeeded. Disabling the adapter restored the identical seeded base output. This verifies loading and inference, not image quality or a Turbo acceleration preset. Big Love notes describe optional ratios from -0.3 to 0.5; the suggested default 0.3 remains disabled. No step count or sigma schedule is applied automatically.
